items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was a great showman, yeah. Sweatman and so forth. Yeah, yeah. A good pattern of showman, yeah.

ctx.x: No, I think he was, uh, uh, I think he was playing, don't wait, am I wrong? Was, it was, did he ever play bass? He played bass, sure. Yeah, all right then, all right. I was wondering, I know he played trombone, he played with us too. We went to the, uh, Royal Gardens on 35th Street. You see, Joe Oliver had left, and he had went someplace. So with this band, we went in there, and, uh, can't think of it, we carried an awful good trumpet player, because we had, we had two trumpets. We had a, we had an awful good…
He was a great showman, yeah. Sweatman and so forth. Yeah, yeah. A good pattern of showman, yeah.
But, uh, we had Freddie Keppard there with us, and he still was, he still was hot.
